If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today. LPL Financial is seeking a VPII, Strategic Pricing to help shape and execute the firm’s enterprise pricing strategy. This leader will play a critical role in defining how LPL prices its platform, products, services, and affiliation models to support growth, margin expansion, client experience, and long-term competitive differentiation. This role is designed for a high-potential strategy and finance leader with the analytical rigor of a top-tier consulting or strategic finance background and the operating maturity to influence senior stakeholders across the organization. The ideal candidate may have experience as a Senior Manager, Engagement Manager, Principal, or early-tenure Partner at a leading strategy consulting firm, or as a strategic finance / corporate strategy leader in a complex financial services organization. The successful candidate will lead a small, high-performing team responsible for translating enterprise strategy into pricing architecture, economic analysis, decision frameworks, implementation roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations. This person must be able to move seamlessly from detailed financial modeling and analytical problem solving to executive storytelling, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. Responsibilities: Develop and maintain LPL’s multi-year pricing strategy, including the pricing architecture, strategic principles, economic targets, and roadmap required to support the firm’s 3- to 5-year objectives. Analyze how LPL makes money across advisor segments, affiliation models, products, platforms, and services; identify opportunities to improve quality of earnings, price realization, margin expansion, growth, retention, and client experience. Lead strategic pricing workstreams across areas such as affiliation model pricing, advisory platform pricing, bundled pricing, advisor incentives, end-client fees, discounting, and fee simplification. Design pricing recommendations that balance commercial impact with advisor experience, end-client experience, competitive positioning, regulatory considerations, operational feasibility, and execution risk. Build and pressure-test financial models, scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and business cases to quantify opportunity size, advisor impact, attrition risk, implementation , and strategic tradeoffs. Frame complex pricing decisions for senior leadership, including the Pricing Committee, Management Committee, C-suite leaders, and Board-level discussions when appropriate. Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Operations, Product, Advisor Experience, Relationship Management, Sales, Communications, and business line leaders to move pricing initiatives from strategy through execution. Translate pricing strategy into implementation roadmaps, including data requirements, operating model needs, communications plans, stakeholder ownership, and change-management considerations. Lead, coach, and develop a small team of pricing strategy professionals, raising the bar on analytical quality, executive communication, strategic judgment, and cross-functional influence. Experience in pricing, monetization, commercial strategy, revenue management, advisor economics, or product and platform profitability. jobs.description: Amazon Shipping is building a high-growth business designed to transform how the world thinks about logistics. We're rapidly expanding our shipping and delivery services to brands and merchants across the U.S., and we're looking for entrepreneurial Business Development leaders who can grow our SMB customer base at scale. As a Sr. Business Developer on our Unmanaged/SMB team, you will own the growth engine for our existing shipper base -- think customer growth team, built for SMB. You'll drive the stabilization, growth, and retention of thousands of self-service shippers, designing the benefits, enablement, and lifecycle programs that make merchants ship more and stay longer -- without one-to-one account management. You will be goaled on incremental revenue from settled shippers and on retention. Key job responsibilities • Own settled-base growth -- segment the existing shipper base, identify expansion opportunity (volume, lanes, services), and build lifecycle programs that grow shipping volume per shipper at scale. • Build the tiered benefits program -- design and launch a non-pricing benefits program (frequent-shipper tiers) that rewards consistent shipping, with a roadmap of benefits that deepen loyalty year over year. • Run enablement at scale -- build the webinar, content, and best-practice engine that makes thousands of merchants successful simultaneously -- onboarding deepening, feature adoption, and shipping optimization programs. • Own retention -- build early-warning signals for at-risk shippers, design proactive and reactive save motions with automation/AI at a scalable ROI, and own the regretted-attrition number. • Own the voice of the shipper (VOS) -- run a scalable mechanism for collecting shipper feedback, walk the store to find friction in the self-service experience, and translate signals into prioritized Product, Tech, and Operations improvements. • Define and own growth metrics -- set program OKRs (incremental revenue from settled shippers, retention and regretted attrition, program engagement, benefit-tier progression), track rigorously, and iterate to maximize ROI. • Work backwards from shipper needs -- earn trust by diving deep into shipper economics, shipping patterns, and pain points to design programs merchants actually value. • Own your domain end-to-end -- operate as the subject matter expert for your channel, define BD strategy that complements the product strategy, and deliver results through scalable mechanisms rather than one-off effort. • Think big and innovate -- replace what account management does for enterprise customers with programs, benefits, and automation that scale to tens of thousands of SMBs. A day in the life You are a growth operator who thrives on making an installed base more valuable. You spend your time in the data segmenting shippers, designing the next benefit tier, reviewing what the VOS mechanism surfaced this week, and measuring which programs actually moved revenue and retention. You're equally comfortable presenting a retention deep-dive to leadership as you are scripting a webinar for a thousand merchants. You operate with startup speed in a big-company environment -- every program you build should serve thousands of shippers, not one. About the team Amazon Shipping is a fast-growing startup within Amazon building the next generation of logistics services for external brands and merchants. We've externalized Amazon's world-class delivery network and are now scaling it rapidly. Our Unmanaged/SMB team owns the self-service segment -- thousands of small and mid-size merchants who ship with us without dedicated account management. We're looking for builders who can create the programs that make this segment grow 10x.

Coupang Fulfillment Services(이하 CFS)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터(Fulfillment Center, 이하 FC) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 이커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
Fulfillment Center(이하 FC)는 쿠팡의 물류센터를 말하는 것으로 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고를 담당하는 곳입니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고가 아닌, 첨단 기술이 집약된 하나의 Automation Factory로서, 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화 하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.

입고 및 출고 프로세스를 관리하며 현장 인력을 효율적으로 운영하여 안정적인 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 운영 데이터를 기반으로 성과를 관리하고 지속적인 프로세스 개선을 추진합니다. 다양한 유관 부서와 협업하며 물류센터 운영 효율 향상에 기여합니다.

recruitingops@coupangfs.com

당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
